title: Ice Cream Truck
blurb: Drive the truck from the drawing, stop for the kids, and sell ice cream. Count the money and fill the jar.
note: Turn the sound on. It speaks.

title: Grammar Bridge
blurb: Put the words in order to build a bridge. Wrong words break and the car falls in.

title: Word Drop Room
blurb: Say an English word and the toy drops into the room. Try “three red apples”.
note: Talking needs Chrome. Allow the microphone when it asks.

title: Little Garden
blurb: Hear it, do it, watch it grow. Plant seeds, water the right bed, pick and count, and meet the animals.
note: Best on an iPad. Say it! needs a browser with speech recognition.

title: Swarm
blurb: Hundreds of shapes chase you. Move, dodge, pick a power-up at each level. Survive 6 minutes.
note: WASD, arrows, or drag. Press M for sound off.

title: Prism
blurb: Turn the mirrors so every beam finds its crystal. Endless levels, each one solved by machine first.
note: Tap a mirror. 💡 shows one to turn.

title: Gravity Golf
blurb: Pull back and let go. Planets bend your shot. Follow the stars to the portal.
note: Hold the screen while it flies to fast-forward.

title: Alphabet Alley
blurb: Hear a sound, find the letter, knock it down. Then sound out short words.
note: Turn the sound on. It speaks.

title: Toy Room
blurb: Put the cat on the bed. Drag toys around a dollhouse room: in, on, under, next to.
note: Turn the sound on. It speaks.

title: Hero Run
blurb: Listen, then tap: jump, duck, left, right, stop, spin. Run a 3D track with the hero.
note: Turn the sound on. It speaks.
